answer:
Change the frontAndBack patch type in constant/polyMesh/boundary from symmetryPlane to empty.
Change the frontAndBack boundary condition in 0/U from wall to empty.
Remove any value entry from the frontAndBack boundary condition in 0/U because an empty boundary condition does not use a value.
Apply the same empty boundary condition to the frontAndBack patches in all other field files, including the pressure field.
Keep the inlet, outlet, and cylinderWall boundary conditions appropriate for a flow-past-cylinder case.
Use pimpleFoam for a transient, incompressible, laminar simulation.
Keep the mesh one cell thick in the spanwise direction.
Do not use symmetryPlane for the frontAndBack patches.
